en: Cuinet says it reported directly to the Interior Ministry, split by Mount Lebanon; by the mid-1890s five sanjaks, 21 cazas, 2,237 villages.
Cuinet says the faculty, subsidised by France, had ten professors and 64 external students by the mid-1890s; Paris examiners gave the doctorate.
He puts Jazzar's age at 84 at death. Wikipedia's biography places his birth in the 1720s-30s, so the age is doubtful.
